layout.arrangement: A large light-gray slide background with a thick red rectangular border inset from the slide edges. Inside the red border is a white square scatter plot occupying most of the area; axes run from -10 to 40 on both x and y with gridlines. Seven colored point clusters are distributed across the plot. A small black curved arrow sits between the red and cyan clusters near the top center. A small yellow circle with the number 42 is in the top-right corner outside the red border but inside the gray slide area. A black strip runs along the bottom edge of the slide.

visual_elements.description: Scatter plot with white background, black axis lines and gridlines. X-axis ticks labeled 0, 10, 20, 30, 40; Y-axis ticks labeled -10, 0, 10, 20, 30, 40. Seven clusters of points: (1) dark blue elongated cluster upper-left centered around x≈10-14, y≈24-26; (2) yellow small cluster mid-left around x≈7-9, y≈12; (3) green small cluster lower-left around x≈7-9, y≈4-5; (4) magenta large cluster lower-center around x≈12-26, y≈6-12; (5) red cluster upper-center around x≈20-25, y≈23-25; (6) black cluster right side around x≈32-37, y≈7-12; (7) cyan cluster upper-right around x≈32-37, y≈22-28. A small black curved arrow is drawn between the red cluster and the cyan cluster near x≈26, y≈29, pointing downward/rightward.

typography_notes: Axis numbers appear to be a simple sans-serif font in black, small size. The slide number 42 inside the yellow circle is black, bold, centered. No other text is visible.
animation_state: Static slide; no indication of mid-build or progressive reveal.
recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to solid light gray (#D3D3D3).
2. Add a thick red (#FF0000) rectangular border inset from the slide edges to frame the plot.
3. Inside the red border, insert a white (#FFFFFF) square scatter-plot area spanning roughly x=22% to x=77% of slide width and y=12% to y=88% of slide height.
4. Add black (#000000) x-axis and y-axis lines with black gridlines. Place x-axis tick labels "0", "10", "20", "30", "40" and y-axis tick labels "-10", "0", "10", "20", "30", "40" in small black sans-serif text.
5. Draw cluster 1: dark blue (#0000FF) elongated point cluster in the upper-left, centered around x≈10-14, y≈24-26.
6. Draw cluster 2: yellow (#FFFF00) small point cluster mid-left, around x≈7-9, y≈12.
7. Draw cluster 3: green (#00FF00) small point cluster lower-left, around x≈7-9, y≈4-5.
8. Draw cluster 4: magenta (#FF00FF) large point cluster lower-center, around x≈12-26, y≈6-12.
9. Draw cluster 5: red (#FF0000) point cluster upper-center, around x≈20-25, y≈23-25.
10. Draw cluster 6: black (#000000) point cluster on the right side, around x≈32-37, y≈7-12.
11. Draw cluster 7: cyan (#00FFFF) point cluster upper-right, around x≈32-37, y≈22-28.
12. Add a small black (#000000) curved arrow between the red and cyan clusters near x≈26, y≈29, pointing downward/rightward.
13. Place a yellow (#FFFF00) circle in the top-right corner outside the red border, containing the black (#000000) bold centered text "42".
14. Add a solid black (#000000) horizontal strip along the bottom edge of the slide.
